description:
The integrations catalogue of aiagentcycle.com (190 systems): name, status, domain, category,
description, open-source license and a detail-page url where one exists. Status: productie = already
running in production at AIAgentCycle or a client; standaard = n8n has a built-in node; maatwerk = custom
via API, export, database or screen automation. Filters: query (name or text, max 100 chars), domain
(administratie, verkoop, samenwerken, data), status, open_source. lang is nl or en. A system that is not
listed can usually still be connected through one of those four routes.

domain.description: Optional domain filter: administratie (finance and admin), verkoop (customers and sales), samenwerken (work and communication) or data (data, servers and AI).

lang.description: Language of the content: nl (Dutch, the primary site language) or en (English).

open_source.description: true for only open-source systems, false for only proprietary ones; leave out for both.

query.description: Optional words that must all occur in the name, description, category or license, for example 'twinfield' or 'crm'. Max 100 characters.

status.description: Optional status filter: productie (running in production), standaard (n8n built-in node) or maatwerk (custom).

name: list_integrations
title: Systems AIAgentCycle integrates
